entities.title: Build and test the crate
entities.summary: Run every test of the Rust library, including both example suites, from a checkout of the repository.
entities.when: Before and after changing anything in implementations/rust.
steps: Install a stable Rust toolchain with Cargo. Cargo.toml asks only for edition 2021 and declares no rust-version (see the backlog item declare-rust-version).
Work in a checkout of the whole repository: the crate compiles in ../../schema/utv-1.0.schema.json, and the tests read ../../conformance/ relative to CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR.
cargo test: the unit and doc tests in src/, every tests/*.rs target and both example suites. No flags are needed; the crate is its own dev-dependency with the feature chrono on.
cargo test --test utv_first runs only the UTV-first examples (cargo test --test native_first the native-first ones).
cargo test --all-features and cargo clippy --all-features --all-targets, as the README's Tests section gives them.
entities.verify: cargo test reports no failed tests.

entities.title: Change or add an example
entities.summary: What else changes when a UTV-first or native-first example changes.
entities.when: A test in tests/utv_first or tests/native_first is added or changed.
steps: Follow AGENTS.md section 1 (GIVEN … THEN sections, a "Verifies that …" doc comment with a second sentence starting "Compared with:").
Keep the other side out of WHEN: chrono's answer is computed in EXPECTATIONS (UTV first), UTV's in EXPECTATIONS (native first).
UTV zone operations use fixtures::demo_zone_rules(), never the host's tz database.
A new scenario gets a test in both suites where chrono or std can do the task, and goes into docs/example-tests.md and the other four languages.
If the test is between // BEGIN <task> and // END <task> markers, run python3 tools/side_by_side.py from the repository root to regenerate docs/side-by-side.md.
Run cargo test here, and python3 tools/side_by_side.py --check from the repository root.
entities.verify: cargo test passes and tools/side_by_side.py --check reports the page up to date.
